issues.detail: The skill does not cover error scenarios or edge cases for user inputs.

scenarios.name: draft-product-launch-okrs
scenarios.rationale: Response A better meets the rubric, providing labeled objectives, baselines, targets, and counter‑metrics, though it includes some activity metrics and lacks a time‑bound aspirational objective; Response B fails on labeling, time‑boundness, baselines, and counter‑metrics.

scenarios.name: review-okrs-measurability

scenarios.name: align-okrs-company
scenarios.rationale: Response B better meets the rubric, providing labeled objectives with baselines, targets, dependencies, and counter‑metrics, though it exceeds the required number of team objectives; Response A fails to meet key rubric items such as single company objective, baseline targets, and objective labeling.
